children: Astera Labs (ALAB) Q3 2026 revenue surged 154% year over year to $584.9 million, beating estimates; non-GAAP EPS reached $1.32. Q4 revenue is forecast at $730 million to $750 million.
Astera Labs, Inc. (ALAB) said its Scorpio fabric-switch product family became its largest, driven by volume production and shipments of the 320-lane Scorpio X-Series switch.
Astera Labs announced its Aries 7 PCIe 7 connectivity portfolio, spanning copper and optical products. Sampling for select customers is expected to begin in Q4 2026.
Astera Labs unveiled Orion, a rack-scale architecture with six designs and a 320-lane PCIe fabric for 8 to 160 accelerators per pod. OEM and ODM availability is expected in Q1 2027.
Astera Labs expanded its Leo controller line with new GPU- and CPU-attached memory products. The Leo X-Series and Leo 2 E- and P-Series support PCIe 6 and CXL 3.2; Leo 2 also supports DDR4 and DDR5.
Astera Labs’ average 12-month price target fell to $409.45 from $414.45, implying about 75% upside from the Nov. 3 close. Ratings stayed Buy: 17 of 25 analysts rated shares Buy and eight Hold.
